ORDINANCE SP EPT (3, 2023
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Maps No. 14-M,
in area bounded by

The alley next north of and parallel to West 63rd Street; A line 33.63 feet east of
and parallel to South Meade Avenue; West 63rd Street, And South Meade Avenue;

To those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6058 W. 63rd Street., Chicago, IL 60638
